# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 4, Chagatai 1347 Split & Eurasian Building-Type Governors (oe_eug_). Generated by gen_eurasia_governors.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# Place domestic building-type governors cleanly (zero land detached, zero cost).
oe_eug_place_dlh_governors = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DLH }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_deccan_recalled }
                c:DLH = { owns = location:gulbarga }
                location:gulbarga = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_deccan } }
            }
            location:gulbarga = {
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_deccan
                    owner = c:DLH
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_malwa_recalled }
                c:DLH = { owns = location:dhar }
                location:dhar = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_malwa } }
            }
            location:dhar = {
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_malwa
                    owner = c:DLH
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_gujarat_recalled }
                c:DLH = { owns = location:khambat }
                location:khambat = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_gujarat } }
            }
            location:khambat = {
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_gujarat
                    owner = c:DLH
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur_recalled }
                c:DLH = { owns = location:jaunpur }
                location:jaunpur = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur } }
            }
            location:jaunpur = {
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur
                    owner = c:DLH
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Sync loyal vs autonomous/factional location modifiers (15m replace, refreshed annually or on state change).
oe_eug_sync_dlh_modifiers = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DLH }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_deccan_recalled }
                c:DLH = { owns = location:gulbarga }
            }
            location:gulbarga = {
                if = {
                    limit = { global_var:oe_eug_dlh_state ?= 2 }
                    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous months = 15 mode = replace }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { global_var:oe_eug_dlh_state ?= 1 }
                    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
                    add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal months = 15 mode = replace }
                }
                else = {
                    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
                    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            location:gulbarga = {

# Recall / abolish domestic governor buildings (triggers remove_if cleanly and clears modifiers).
oe_eug_recall_dlh_governors = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_state value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_deccan_recalled value = 1 }
    location:gulbarga = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_malwa_recalled value = 1 }
    location:dhar = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_gujarat_recalled value = 1 }
    location:khambat = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur_recalled value = 1 }
    location:jaunpur = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
}

oe_eug_recall_mam_governors = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_mam_state value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_mam_damascus_recalled value = 1 }
    location:damascus = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_mam_aleppo_recalled value = 1 }
    location:aleppo = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional }
    }
}

# Execute 1347 Chagatai East-West split: delegates to oe_chgu_execute_full_east_west_split (v21.0:
# releases all 14 West Wing amirs while keeping East Wing 3 amirs DGH/QCH/BSB with CHG/Moghulistan),
# and applies the regional oe_eug flavor names and buffs.
oe_eug_execute_chg_split = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_split value = 1 }
    oe_chgu_execute_full_east_west_split = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHG }
        c:CHG = {
            change_country_name = OE_EUG_NAME_MOGHULISTAN
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_moghulistan_east years = 40 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YSU }
        c:YSU = {
            change_country_name = OE_EUG_NAME_TRANSOXIANA
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_west_transoxiana years = 40 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BRL }
        c:BRL = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_west_transoxiana years = 30 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DGH }
        c:DGH = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_moghulistan_east years = 35 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# Initialize global state & place initial domestic building-type governors (idempotent).
oe_eug_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_init } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_init value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_on value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_crisis value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_split value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_islam value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_state value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_mam_state value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_hun_state value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt value = 0 }
        oe_eug_place_dlh_governors = yes
        oe_eug_place_mam_governors = yes
        oe_eug_place_hun_governors = yes
        oe_eug_sync_dlh_modifiers = yes
        oe_eug_sync_mam_modifiers = yes
        oe_eug_sync_hun_modifiers = yes
    }
}

# Monthly tick (scheduler slot 50, also called by oe_eug_fallback_pulse if BYZ falls).
# World line: takes NO BYZ main-line lock; idempotent per calendar month via oe_eug_ran_m.
oe_eug_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_ran_m ?= oe_eug_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ran_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
        oe_eug_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_on }
            # Annual January refresh of active governor modifiers (mode = replace, 15m duration).
            if = {
                limit = { current_month = 1 }
                oe_eug_sync_dlh_modifiers = yes
                oe_eug_sync_mam_modifiers = yes
                oe_eug_sync_hun_modifiers = yes
            }
            # Event dispatch (at most one oe_eug event per calendar month).
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_ev_m ?= oe_eug_m_now } }
                # ---- Chagatai 1347 split (.1-.4)
                if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1343 current_year <= 1350 country_exists = c:CHG NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_1 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_1 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:CHG = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.1 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        current_year >= 1346 current_year <= 1355
                        country_exists = c:CHG
                        NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_chg_split ?= 2 }
                        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_2 }
                    }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_2 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:CHG = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.2 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1351 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_3 } OR = { country_exists = c:CHG country_exists = c:DGH } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_3 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:DGH c:DGH = { is_ai = no } }
                        c:DGH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.3 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:CHG }
                        c:CHG = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.3 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:DGH }
                        c:DGH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.3 }
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1360 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_4 } OR = { country_exists = c:YSU country_exists = c:BRL country_exists = c:CHG } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_4 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:YSU c:YSU = { is_ai = no } }
                        c:YSU = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.4 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:BRL c:BRL = { is_ai = no } }
                        c:BRL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.4 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:YSU }
                        c:YSU = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.4 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:BRL }
                        c:BRL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.4 }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:CHG }
                        c:CHG = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.4 }
                    }
                }
                # ---- Delhi 4 Viceroyalties (.5-.7)
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1338 country_exists = c:DLH NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_5 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_5 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:DLH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.5 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1342 oe_eug_dlh_in_crisis = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_dlh_state ?= 3 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_6 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_6 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:DLH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.6 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1351 country_exists = c:DLH NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_dlh_state ?= 3 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_7 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_7 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:DLH = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.7 }
                }
                # ---- Mamluk 2 Syrian Naibs (.8-.9)
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1340 country_exists = c:MAM NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_mam_state ?= 3 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_8 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_8 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:MAM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.8 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1382 country_exists = c:MAM NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_mam_state ?= 3 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_9 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_9 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:MAM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.9 }
                }
                # ---- Hungary Regional Offices (.10)
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1382 country_exists = c:HUN NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_hun_state ?= 3 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_10 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_10 value = 1 }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_m value = oe_eug_m_now }
                    change_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_ev_cnt add = 1 }
                    c:HUN = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eug.10 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_eug_job_11 = {
set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_crisis value = 1 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_hammer years = 12 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YSU country_exists = c:CHG }
        c:YSU = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_amir_revolt target = c:CHG } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BRL country_exists = c:CHG }
        c:BRL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_amir_revolt target = c:CHG } }
    }
}

oe_eug_job_31 = {
set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_islam value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { religion = religion:sunni } }
        change_religion = religion:sunni
    }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_moghul_islamization years = 30 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:DGH }
        c:DGH = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { religion = religion:sunni } } change_religion = religion:sunni }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_moghul_islamization years = 25 mode = replace }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:CHG }
            c:CHG = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_moghul_bond target = c:DGH } }
            c:DGH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_moghul_bond target = c:CHG } }
        }
    }
}

oe_eug_test_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_init } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_on } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ran_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_m } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_cnt } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_cnt }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_crisis } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_crisis }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_split } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_split }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_islam } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_chg_islam }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_state } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_state }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_state } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_state }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_state } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_state }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_deccan_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_deccan_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_malwa_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_malwa_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_gujarat_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_gujarat_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_dlh_jaunpur_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_damascus_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_damascus_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_aleppo_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_mam_aleppo_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_transylvania_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_transylvania_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_croatia_recalled } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_hun_croatia_recalled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_2 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_5 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_6 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_6 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_7 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_7 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_8 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_8 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_9 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_9 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_10 } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_10 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_hammer } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_hammer }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_compromise } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_compromise }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_west_transoxiana } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_west_transoxiana }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_moghulistan_east } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_moghulistan_east }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_restored } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_restored }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_moghul_islamization } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_moghul_islamization }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_silk_road_pluralism } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_silk_road_pluralism }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_samarkand_amirate } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_samarkand_amirate }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_chagatai_warbands } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_chagatai_warbands }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_firuz_settlement } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_firuz_settlement }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_imperial_diwan } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_imperial_diwan }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_mam_burji_guard } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_mam_burji_guard }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_mam_cairo_centralized } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_mam_cairo_centralized }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_hun_ottoman_bulwark } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_hun_ottoman_bulwark }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_eug_hun_royal_prerogative } remove_country_modifier = oe_eug_hun_royal_prerogative }
    location:gulbarga = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    location:dhar = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    location:khambat = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    location:jaunpur = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_dlh_iqta_autonomous }
    }
    location:damascus = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional }
    }
    location:aleppo = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_mam_naib_factional }
    }
    location:brasov = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_autonomous }
    }
    location:zagreb = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_loyal }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_autonomous } remove_location_modifier = oe_eug_hun_voivode_autonomous }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_eug_dlh_audit_cd } remove_variable = oe_eug_dlh_audit_cd }
}

oe_eug_test_start = {
    oe_eug_test_clear = yes
    oe_eug_init = yes
}

oe_eug_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_init } } oe_eug_init = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ran_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_m } remove_global_variable = oe_eug_ev_m }
    oe_eug_monthly = yes
}
